			limit = {
				is_rebel_country = no
				NOT = { is_allied_with = { target = root } }
				NOT = { is_subject_of = root }
			}
			add_opinion = { target = root modifier = oe_heg2_op_hegemonic_fear }
		}
	}
	option = {

# 90. Dev Panel Page 81 Read-Only Audit Dashboard (Slot 85 oe_heg2_ Live Telemetry)
oe_heg2.90 = {
	type = country_event
	title = oe_heg2.90.title
	outcome = neutral
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/government/geopolitics_illustration.dds"
	trigger = { is_rebel_country = no }

	immediate = {
		random_great_power = {
			limit = { is_hegemon_type = hegemony:military_hegemon }
			save_scope_as = oe_heg2_h_mil
		}
		random_great_power = {
			limit = { is_hegemon_type = hegemony:naval_hegemon }
			save_scope_as = oe_heg2_h_nav
		}
		random_great_power = {
			limit = { is_hegemon_type = hegemony:economic_hegemon }
			save_scope_as = oe_heg2_h_eco
		}
		random_great_power = {
			limit = { is_hegemon_type = hegemony:cultural_hegemon }
			save_scope_as = oe_heg2_h_cul
		}
		random_great_power = {
			limit = { is_hegemon_type = hegemony:diplomatic_hegemon }
			save_scope_as = oe_heg2_h_dip
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_variable = oe_heg2_polar_leader }
			global_var:oe_heg2_polar_leader ?= {
				if = {
					limit = { num_locations > 0 }
					save_scope_as = oe_heg2_rd_leader
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_variable = oe_heg2_polar_rival }
			global_var:oe_heg2_polar_rival ?= {
				if = {
					limit = { num_locations > 0 }
					save_scope_as = oe_heg2_rd_rival
				}
			}
		}
	}

	desc = {
		desc = oe_heg2.90.desc_header
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = { trigger = { exists = scope:oe_heg2_h_mil } desc = oe_heg2.90.desc_mil_yes }
			desc = oe_heg2.90.desc_mil_no
		}
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = { trigger = { exists = scope:oe_heg2_h_nav } desc = oe_heg2.90.desc_nav_yes }
			desc = oe_heg2.90.desc_nav_no
		}
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = { trigger = { exists = scope:oe_heg2_h_eco } desc = oe_heg2.90.desc_eco_yes }
			desc = oe_heg2.90.desc_eco_no
		}
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = { trigger = { exists = scope:oe_heg2_h_cul } desc = oe_heg2.90.desc_cul_yes }
			desc = oe_heg2.90.desc_cul_no
		}
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = { trigger = { exists = scope:oe_heg2_h_dip } desc = oe_heg2.90.desc_dip_yes }
			desc = oe_heg2.90.desc_dip_no
		}
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = { trigger = { exists = scope:oe_heg2_rd_leader } desc = oe_heg2.90.desc_leader_yes }
			desc = oe_heg2.90.desc_leader_no
		}
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = { trigger = { exists = scope:oe_heg2_rd_rival } desc = oe_heg2.90.desc_rival_yes }
			desc = oe_heg2.90.desc_rival_no
		}
		desc = oe_heg2.90.desc_footer
	}

	option = {
		name = oe_heg2.90.a
		ai_chance = { base = 100 }
	}
	option = {
		name = oe_heg2.90.b
		ai_chance = { base = 0 }
		oe_heg2_refresh_polar_cache = yes
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_heg2.90
	}
}
